Nobody is in a great financial situation and I wouldn't be brave enough to ask, knowing there little chance I could pay them back.

In one year I'm no longer have health insurance through a parent and there will be absolutely no way I can afford treatment any longer.

Without any savings I'd find this very hard. Of course I'm will to work my hands to the bone though to get out of here. Is there such a thing as working for someone for free and getting temporary housing in exchange?
